user.title: Connect to My Bank API
user.description: My Bank needs a running My Bank API server (Home Assistant add-on or Docker container).

create_transfer.description: Moves money between two accounts: two twin transactions, each with its own state.

amount.description: Positive amount, debited from one account and credited to the other.

list_classes.description: Returns the class tree as a flat list.

list_account_transactions.description: Returns the transactions of an account over a period, with the balance after each line.

include_subcategories.name: Include subcategories

create_budget.name: Create budget
create_budget.description: Creates a budget for an account over a range of months.

update_budget.name: Update budget
update_budget.description: Changes a budget; only the fields given are changed.

delete_budget.name: Delete budget
delete_budget.description: Deletes a budget and all its amounts.

set_budget_lines.name: Set budget grid
set_budget_lines.description: Saves the categories × months grid of a budget (positive amounts, in the category's direction).

copy_budget.name: Copy budget
copy_budget.description: Copies a budget to a new period with the same amounts.

budget_id.name: Budget to copy
budget_id.description: Id of the budget to copy.

start_month.name: First month
start_month.description: First month (YYYY-MM); default: the month after the copied budget.

months.name: Number of months
months.description: Number of months; default: same as the copied budget.

account_id.name: Account
account_id.description: Account id; default: the same account.

list_upcoming_occurrences.name: List upcoming occurrences
list_upcoming_occurrences.description: Returns the occurrences due within a number of days, and the overdue ones.

list_schedule_occurrences.description: Returns every occurrence of a scheduled transaction with its status.

upcoming.description: For a schedule without end: number of upcoming occurrences to return.

get_budget_lines.name: Get budget grid
get_budget_lines.description: Returns the planned amounts of a budget, per category and month.

get_budget_report.name: Get budget report
get_budget_report.description: Returns planned, actual and variance of a budget, per category and month.

create_shared_account.name: Create shared account
create_shared_account.description: Creates a shared account to settle a group's common expenses.

participants.name: Participants
participants.description: Names of the participants (at least two, yourself included).

update_shared_account.name: Update shared account
update_shared_account.description: Renames, closes or reopens a shared account.

delete_shared_account.description: Deletes a shared account with its participants and expenses.

add_shared_participant.description: Adds a participant to a shared account.

rename_shared_participant.description: Renames a participant of a shared account.

remove_shared_participant.name: Remove participant
remove_shared_participant.description: Removes a participant who has paid nothing (at least two must remain).

add_shared_expense.name: Add shared expense
add_shared_expense.description: Records an expense paid by a participant of a shared account.

participant_id.name: Paid by

update_shared_expense.description: Changes an expense of a shared account.

participant_id.name: Paid by
participant_id.description: Id of the participant who paid.

delete_shared_expense.name: Delete shared expense
delete_shared_expense.description: Deletes an expense of a shared account.

list_shared_accounts.description: Returns the shared accounts with totals, next payer and repayments.

get_shared_account.name: Get shared account
get_shared_account.description: Returns a shared account with its expenses, shares and repayments.

account_id.description: Id of the account whose transactions are moved.

target_id.name: Target
target_id.description: Id of the item that receives the transactions.

include_reconciled.name: Include reconciled
include_reconciled.description: Also move reconciled transactions (both reconciled balances change).

move_category.description: Moves every transaction and schedule of a category to another category.

category_id.name: Source category
category_id.description: Id of the category whose transactions are moved.

target_id.name: Target
target_id.description: Id of the item that receives the transactions.

move_class.name: Move class transactions
move_class.description: Moves every transaction and schedule of a class to another class.

class_id.name: Source class
class_id.description: Id of the class whose transactions are moved.

target_id.name: Target
target_id.description: Id of the item that receives the transactions.

move_payee.name: Move payee transactions
move_payee.description: Moves every transaction and schedule of a payee to another payee (merge).

payee_id.name: Source payee
payee_id.description: Id of the payee whose transactions are moved.

target_id.name: Target
target_id.description: Id of the item that receives the transactions.
